title: Mokaterm gallery entry
description: gallery/<id>.json: a community plugin, built from source at one commit. build/gallery_schema.py reads this file to check entries, plugins/<id>/listing.json ($defs/listing) and gallery/withdrawn.json ($defs/withdrawn), so the rules live here and nowhere else.

id.description: The plugin id, as MokatermPluginId and plugin.json say, and the file's name without .json. Community ids have a dot in them (publisher.plugin) and never start with moka. or mokaterm., which are ours.

source.description: The public GitHub repository the plugin is built from, as https://github.com/owner/name, with no .git and no slash at the end.

commit.description: The full commit to build, 40 lower-case hex characters.

tag.description: Optional: the tag on that commit, for people reading the entry. The check makes sure it points at the commit.

project.description: The plugin's .csproj inside the repository, with forward slashes.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier or a simple expression of them (MIT, Apache-2.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0).

categories.description: Where the Browse tab lists the plugin.

listing.title: plugins/<id>/listing.json
listing.description: What plugin.json does not say about one of our own plugins.

withdrawn.title: gallery/withdrawn.json
withdrawn.description: Versions the app must not offer any more, ours and community ones alike, each with the sentence the app shows.
